entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return this VeloBand Pulse thing. It's been a complete waste of my money.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?
The name is Mark Sterling. The order number is... V-F-7-8-8-9-1. Now hurry up, I don't have all day.

Thank you, Mr. Sterling. I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. I understand you'd like to make a return. To make sure I'm assisting you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?
What does it matter? I don't want it! There's no issue, I just don't want it. I changed my mind. It was an impulse buy and I simply don't use it. This shouldn't be this complicated!
I understand completely. Thank you for clarifying that for me. One moment while I review our return policy for your item.
Review? It better be a return, or I'm lighting you up on every social media platform and review site I can find. I am a VIP member, you know.

I appreciate your patience, Mr. Sterling. Okay, I've just checked our knowledge base. It states that all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you received the item 40 days ago, you are unfortunately outside the window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.
Oh. Well... good. It's about time. So what happens now?

I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account right now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box with the device inside, and drop it at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. As a thank you for your patience and for being a valued VIP member, I've also added a $50 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchases.
The email just came through. A credit, you say? Fine. That's acceptable. Thank you, Diana.
You're very welcome, Mr. Sterling. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
